Aurangzeb, the Mughal emperor, sought to expand his empire and suppress the Maratha kingdom. In 1689, Sambhaji was captured by Mughal forces led by Muqarrab Khan at Sangameshwar. Aurangzeb offered Sambhaji a pardon if he would surrender his forts, reveal hidden treasures, and name Mughal officers who were his informers.
